confirm_legacy.title: Acknowledge legacy EMOS control risk
confirm_legacy.description: Only enable for change-only EMOS hardware you have verified physically stopped. This mode permits unknown feedback and sends OFF, waits the safety delay, then sends ON without observing OFF. Successful services do not confirm relay output, motion, position or arrival. Remembered positions are unverified. Timer OFF is mandatory but cannot guarantee de-energizing during HA/network/device failure. Use independent hardware interlocks, limits and timers. Enabling itself does not operate relays.

init.description: Save only while stopped, without pending commands or known-ON relays. Mode changes allow unknown, but not missing, disabled or unavailable sources. Options do not reload or operate relays. Standard is the default. Legacy EMOS bypasses observed-OFF confirmation and forces timer stop.

set_auto_stop_at_travel_end.name: Set travel-end auto-stop
set_auto_stop_at_travel_end.description: Save auto-stop for loaded UNiNUS dual-switch Covers without reload or relay actuation. Both relays must be off, with no command pending. Applies to the next Cover command; all targets are validated before any write.

entity_id.name: Cover entities
entity_id.description: One Cover entity ID or a nonempty list of this integration's loaded Covers. Native MQTT Covers are not supported.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: True turns off both relays after the next Cover command's travel time. False relies on hardware or switch timers instead; only a boolean is accepted. Legacy EMOS mode rejects false.

apply_parameters.name: Apply hardware parameters atomically
apply_parameters.description: Active administrators with entity CONTROL only; loaded owned dual-switch Covers only, never native_cover. Requires idle commands/timers and both relays known off. Verifies the saved disk record. Travel changes invalidate estimates.

parameters.name: Hardware parameters
parameters.description: Nonempty numeric mapping containing only open_travel_time, close_travel_time, reverse_dead_time, off_confirmation_timeout.

expected_revision.name: Expected revision
expected_revision.description: Optional nonnegative integer; stale revisions reject without mutation.
